'''Blade''' can refer to the following:

== Blades ==
* [[Dueling blades]] - a matched pair of blades used for dueling in the [[Age of Legends]].
* [[Half-moon axe]] - and axe given to [[Perrin Aybara]] by [[Haral Luhhan]].
* [[Blademaster#Heron mark|Heron-marked blades]] - swords which carry a heron mark on the hilt and indicate a mastery of sword fighting.
* [[Power-wrought blade]] - a blade created using the [[One Power]].
* [[Thakan'dar|Thakan'dar-wrought blades]] - a blade carried by a [[Myrddraal]], forged in Thakan'dar (popularly called '''fade blades''').

== People and titles ==
* [[Master of the Blades]] - the male counter part to the [[Mistress of the Ships]] among the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]''.
* [[Blademaster]] - someone who has demonstrated extraordinary proficiency with a sword.
* [[True Blade of Malkier]] - one of the titles of [[al'Lan Mandragoran]], King of [[Malkier]].
* [[Mandarb]] - [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s horse, whose name means "blade" in the [[List of Old Tongue words#M|Old Tongue]].

== Chapter titles ==
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 45|Blademaster]]'' - the forty-fifth chapter of ''The Great Hunt''.
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 21|The Gift of a Blade]]'' - the twenty-first chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 36|Blades]]'' - the thirty-sixth chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.

== Others ==
* The [[Plowman's Blade]] - an inn located in the [[Kandor]]i village of [[Manala]].
* ''[[The Flame, the Blade and the Heart]]'' - an adventure book about [[Birgitte Silverbow]] and [[Gaidal Cain]].
